        created_at: Timestamp when the entry was first created.
        updated_at: Timestamp when the entry was last accessed/updated.
        ttl: Time-to-live in seconds.
        status: Current status of the entry.
    """

    value: Any
    created_at: float
    updated_at: float
    ttl: float
    status: CacheStatus = CacheStatus.VALID
    
    def is_expired(self, current_time: Optional[float] = None) -> bool:
        """
        Check if the entry has expired based on its TTL.
        
        Args:
            current_time: Optional current time. If None, uses time.time().
            
        Returns:
            True if the entry is expired, False otherwise.
        """
        if current_time is None:
            current_time = time.time()
        
        expiration_time = self.created_at + self.ttl
        return current_time >= expiration_time
